rejection_rationale.kalshi_nyc_temp_hourly: 3,976 hourly temperature binary markets (KXTEMPNYCH series) - individually verifiable but too granular and redundant for curation. These are binary options on specific hourly NYC temperatures, not meaningful prediction markets for geo-analysis.
rejection_rationale.polymarket_city_temp_daily: 768 daily city temperature markets across 30+ cities - verifiable by weather stations but duplicative. Kept only representative active ones and excluded expired single-day forecasts.
rejection_rationale.manifold_opinion_climate: ~200 Manifold markets about climate policy, opinion, activism (e.g., 'Will climate change be solved?', 'Should smart people go into climate tech?') - not measurable by geospatial data.
rejection_rationale.metaculus_nuclear_policy: ~150 Metaculus questions about nuclear weapons/policy - geopolitical predictions, not natural phenomena verifiable by satellite/sensors.
rejection_rationale.manifold_fiction_pop_culture: ~80 Manifold markets referencing 'fire' in fiction (Avatar: Fire and Ash, Game of Thrones, Walking Dead wildfire virus) or sports teams (Miami Hurricanes, San Jose Earthquakes, Carolina Hurricanes).
rejection_rationale.political_speech_bets: Markets like 'Will Obama say climate change at DNC?' or 'Will Trump say hurricane during rally?' - about political speech, not geospatial phenomena.

notes: Volume figures are in platform-native units: USD for Polymarket/Kalshi, Mana for Manifold, prediction count for Metaculus.
Probability values represent the last known market price or community prediction at time of scraping (2026-04-07).
Active bets are sorted first, then by volume descending.
Markets about crypto tokens (Celsius Network, Avalanche), sports teams (Miami Hurricanes, San Jose Earthquakes), fiction (Game of Thrones fire/ice), and political speech were explicitly excluded.
Kalshi's 3,976 hourly NYC temperature markets were excluded as individually they represent binary options, not meaningful prediction markets, though they are technically geo-verifiable.
AI analyses reference conditions as of April 2026 and are based on publicly available scientific data and forecast model outputs.
